text:
hannah: Hey folks — quick spontaneous idea: alfresco quiz + potluck + pop-up ping-pong this Wednesday 7pm on the plaza. BYO blanket/chair. Low-key. :question: :taco:

marc: I'm in. Can we keep trivia to ~30m? Early call after.

sophia: I'll bring a vegan casserole. Any nut allergies I should watch for?

raj: Tree nuts for me — thanks for asking. I can run a casual ping-pong bracket.

felix: I can bring a foldable net, 3 paddles, and a small speaker. Also vote: tacos or pizza?

ivy: Tacos please. Might bring my little one for the stroll afterward, so kid-friendly stuff appreciated.

hannah: Plan B if drizzle -> mezzanine lounge. Final call by 3pm Wednesday.

sophia: Tiny poll — react with :taco: for tacos, :pizza: for pizza, :game_die: for games-first, :baby: if you're bringing kids.

marc: :taco: :game_die:

raj: :game_die:

felix: :taco:

ivy: :baby: :taco:

events-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Alfresco Quiz + Potluck + Ping-Pong" Wed 19:00 — reminder at 16:00.

reminder-bot: Event created: "Plaza Potluck & Games" Wed 19:00 — guest list updated. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/2611112223

hannah: Great — looks like tacos + games + kids welcome. I'll make a shopping/checklist and mark nut-free dishes. If someone can grab ice please volunteer.

marc: I'll take ice + napkins.

sophia: I'll label my casserole and bring serving spoons.

raj: Trivia plan: 6 rounds, 5 questions each, tiny silly trophy for winners. I'll emcee.

felix: Bringing fairy lights and a battery pack in case it gets dim.

ivy: I can bring a folding kid blanket and juice boxes.

hannah: Thanks team! If anyone wants to claim a specific item (plates, cups, cutlery) reply with the item. See you Wednesday — bring good vibes and elastic waistbands. :sparkles:
